plugins.name: my
plugins.description: The my method for building software with Claude: one roadmap orders the work, each change gets the process its risk needs, a second reader reviews every spec, plan and branch, and each branch lands on main as one squash commit. Depends on superpowers. A folder turns it on with /kit:setup my.
